purpose: one-time gate for replacing the merged scalar Python scorer with the Cython genotype kernel
numerical_parity: passed for every likelihood component and posterior
decision: Cython is the sole production genotype-scoring implementation; the Python scorer and runtime backend selector are removed.
scope_note: This deterministic expanded-catalogue workload proves that the grouped Cython kernel materially improves the previously merged implementation. It is not a claim about complete end-to-end runtime on every assay or dataset.
